# Tactyqal Labs

> A youth entrepreneurship platform powered by Tactyq, an AI business coach that helps student founders validate ideas, build startups, and develop no-code applications.

Tactyqal Labs is dedicated to nurturing the next generation of entrepreneurs through AI-powered mentoring, idea validation tools, and comprehensive startup programs. The platform has supported diverse ventures including KrishiDrishti, Elenor Vegan Handbags, AudioNova, and other student-led startups across India.

## Key Topics

- Tactyq AI business coach
- Idea validation
- Youth entrepreneurship
- Startup mentoring
- Idea generation
- Business validation
- No-code development
- Entrepreneur platform
- 8-week course
- Student success stories
- Startup tools
- App-building program
- Revenue generation
- College admissions
- Founder guidance

## Tactyq AI Business Coach

- [Tactyq - AI business coach](https://www.tactyqal.com/index.php/Questions/ideaDisplayer): Tactyq AI business coach for idea generation and startup validation
- [Tactyq Idea Evaluation Tool](https://www.tactyqal.com/index.php/Questions/generatedIdea): Tactyq idea evaluation tool with customer validation questions for entrepreneurs
- [Startup Assessment & Founder Guidance](https://www.tactyqal.com/Tests): Tactyq startup assessment tests and founder guidance tools for idea validation
